features.description: Apache-2.0 TypeScript CLI (npm @google/gemini-cli, Node 20+) bringing Gemini models into the terminal for codebase work.
OAuth login with a personal Google account gives Gemini Code Assist for individuals: 1,000 model requests/day and 60/minute free (model mix limited by the tier).
Set GEMINI_API_KEY from Google AI Studio; unpaid tier allows 250 model requests/user/day (10/min) on Flash models only.
Enterprise path via Application Default Credentials + gcloud, Service Account JSON keys, or Cloud API keys, plus a billing-free Express Mode.
Google AI Pro / AI Ultra subscriptions or pay-as-you-go API billing raise limits when free tiers are exhausted.
Choose models via `gemini -m <model>`, the /model command, or model.name in settings.json; Gemini 2.5 Pro offers a 1M-token context window.
Core tools cover file system operations, shell execution, web fetch, Google Search grounding, multi-file reads (read-many-files), and a save-memory tool for cross-session recall.
Accepts images, PDFs, and sketches in prompts; landing page demos generating apps from PDFs/images.
Configure MCP servers in settings.json mcpServers across Stdio, SSE, and Streamable HTTP transports, with global mcp.allowed/mcp.excluded allowlists.
OAuth 2.0 for SSE/HTTP MCP servers with automatic discovery, dynamic client registration, /mcp auth management, token refresh, and google_credentials / service-account-impersonation provider types.
Reusable /commands as .toml files in ~/.gemini/commands (user) and .gemini/commands (project), with namespaced paths, argument injection, and multimodal embedding.
Command templates can execute shell commands with !{...} and inject file/directory/image content with @{...} before the prompt is sent.
Slash command to list, reload, and manage custom .toml commands across user, project, and extension sources.
Context files load from ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md, project root/ancestors, and subdirectories; concatenated into every prompt; filename is configurable (e.g. AGENTS.md).
Manage instructional memory in-session: add text to global memory, show/refresh/reload, and list loaded GEMINI.md paths; /init bootstraps a project GEMINI.md.
Break memory into modules imported with @./file.md, with nested imports, circular-import detection, path validation, and a max import depth.
With --checkpointing or settings, each approved file-modifying tool call creates a shadow-Git checkpoint; /restore lists and rolls back files and conversation.
Sessions save automatically; resume via --resume/-r (latest or by index), the /resume session browser, --list-sessions, --delete-session, and configurable retention policies.
/resume save <tag>, /resume list, and /resume resume <tag> create named branch points of conversation state (aliases under /chat).
Navigate backward through conversation history to revisit or steer away from earlier turns.

Read-only mode via /plan or --approval-mode plan (Shift+Tab cycles Default/Auto-Edit/Plan): research and design with only read/search tools, collaborative plan editing, and approval to exit into execution.
--approval-mode default/auto_edit/yolo (or --yolo) controls tool confirmations; --allowed-tools pre-approves specific tools; YOLO auto-enables sandboxing.
TOML policy files in ~/.gemini/policies (and system-managed tiers) decide allow/deny/confirm per tool and argument regex, with mode-scoped rules and a priority tier system.

Isolate shell and file operations via macOS Seatbelt profiles (permissive/restrictive, network on/off) or Docker/Podman containers, enabled with -s, GEMINI_SANDBOX, settings, or custom .gemini/sandbox.Dockerfile.

Folder-trust dialog restricts untrusted workspaces to a safe mode that ignores project settings and blocks risky behavior; trust rules live in ~/.gemini/trustedFolders.json and are managed via /permissions.
Command hooks in settings.json fire on lifecycle events (SessionStart, BeforeTool, AfterTool, ...), can inject context, block or rewrite tool calls, and are managed via /hooks.

Specialist agents run in their own context windows with custom tools and prompts; built-in ones auto-delegate, @name forces one, and custom agents are Markdown+frontmatter files in ~/.gemini/agents or project .gemini/agents.
Slash command to list, reload, and manage local and remote subagents.

Agent Skills standard folders (SKILL.md + resources) discovered from built-in, extension, user (~/.gemini/skills, .agents/skills), and workspace tiers; installed via `gemini skills install` and managed with /skills.

Installable bundles (gemini extensions install from a GitHub URL or local path) that package MCP servers, context files, custom commands, agents, and excluded tools via gemini-extension.json; enable/disable/update/link per scope.
Browseable gallery of community extensions at geminicli.com/extensions.
`gemini --worktree <name>` (-w) creates an isolated worktree+branch under .gemini/worktrees for parallel sessions; work survives exit and can be resumed.
Run with -p/--prompt or stdin pipes, --output-format json for structured responses/stats, consistent exit codes, and file redirection for scripting and CI.
Work across extra directories via --include-directories or /directory add; /directory show lists the active workspace roots.
Companion extension for VS Code and forks (Open VSX) installed via /ide install; shares recent files, cursor position, and selection, renders diffs natively, and accepts/rejects them from the IDE.
Official Gemini CLI GitHub Action (google-github-actions/run-gemini-cli) for PR review, issue triage, and @gemini-cli mentions; /setup-github configures it from the CLI.
/theme switches built-in dark/light themes (ANSI, Atom One, Ayu, Dracula, GitHub, Google Code, Xcode, ...); custom themes via ui.customThemes in settings.json or theme files.
/vim toggles vim keybindings with NORMAL/INSERT editing in the input area.
Default and customizable shortcuts (reference table) incl. Tab to queue a message while the agent works, Ctrl+T TODO list, and F12 debug console.
/compress replaces the chat with a summary; automatic compression triggers when history crosses a configurable fraction (default 0.7) of the model's token limit.
Automatic API token caching with API-key auth reuses system instructions/context to cut costs; /stats shows cached-token savings.
/stats reports session token usage and duration; /settings opens an in-CLI settings editor; /upgrade opens the Code Assist upgrade page.
System-wide settings files, GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH enforcement wrapper, tools.core allowlists, policy-level YOLO disabling, and GEMINI_CLI_HOME user isolation for shared hosts.
Usage-statistics collection is on by default; /privacy shows the notice and toggles consent; privacy policy is documented separately.
Weekly stable and preview npm tags plus a nightly tag for testing unvetted builds.

Also ships /about, /auth (change auth method), /bug (file GitHub issue from the CLI), /clear, /copy (clipboard), /docs, /editor, /shells (background shell view), /terminal-setup, /mcp (server & tool inspection), /tools, /privacy, /quit.

Per the official docs banner, unpaid-tier and Google One users were moved from Gemini CLI to the new Antigravity CLI on June 18, 2026; paid Code Assist licenses and API-key auth continue on Gemini CLI.
